## Back up first

Take a verified physical backup with binary logging enabled (for example Percona XtraBackup or MySQL Enterprise Backup) so point-in-time recovery is possible. mysqldump --single-transaction is a supplement only, for portable or partial restore. A replica or standby is not a backup. Restore the backup to a separate instance and verify it before relying on it, and record the time so the recovery point is known.

Run steps in numeric order. Use each `.up.sql` only after its prechecks pass. The `.down.sql` files are rollbacks; where a step cannot be reversed without loss, the file says so and contains no statements.
